name: <Brand name>
wordmark: <Text shown next to the mark, or null to use name>

do: Accent colour only for the primary action and one highlight per frame
dont: No springs or bounce on UI
No claims that are not in the content source

_doc.colors: Hex values. bg = page/video background, surface/surface2 = cards and rows, line = borders, accent = the one CTA/highlight colour, accentInk = text on accent.
_doc.type: Font files live next to brand.json (fonts/). Weights you list are the only weights that exist — the engines never fake bold. Run tools/glyph_check.py on your copy.
_doc.background: type = mesh (5x5 colour grid, top row first) | flat (uses colors.bg) | image (set background.image to a file in this folder).
_doc.logo: mark = SVG with plain <path> elements. Paths tagged data-role="glyph" are what the launch-teaser particles assemble into.
_doc.rules: Read by Claude before writing copy. claimsSource = path to the doc every on-screen claim must come from.
